label: model, not an edge
note: Our own NFL model: team ratings from every final score (margin, offence, defence), home field, rest, and the way NFL scores land on 3, 7 and 10. It is a model, not a proven edge: in the held-out test on 2025-26 games, Kalshi's price an hour before kickoff beat it.

backtest.verdict: moneyline failed the pre-registered bar; spreads and totals pending
